# OpenCV Help

> Comprehensive tutorials and guides for mastering OpenCV, computer vision, and image/video processing in Python.

OpenCV Help provides structured learning resources for developers at all levels, from installation and fundamentals to advanced techniques like deep learning integration and 3D reconstruction. The site covers practical applications across robotics, surveillance, and real-world computer vision projects.

## Key Topics

- OpenCV
- Computer Vision
- Python
- Image Processing
- Video Processing
- Object Detection
- Face Detection
- Deep Learning
- Edge Detection
- Optical Flow
- Template Matching
- Kalman Filtering
- Installation & Setup
- Getting Started
- Beginner Guide

## Getting Started

- [Introduction to OpenCV](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/introduction): Getting started guide covering OpenCV installation, setup, and first program in Python

## Core Tutorials

- [Image Processing with OpenCV](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/image-processing): Tutorial series on image processing techniques including filtering and edge detection
- [Video Processing with OpenCV](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/video-processing): Complete tutorials on video processing, object tracking, and motion analysis with OpenCV
- [Image Analysis with OpenCV](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/image-analysis): Tutorials on image analysis covering feature extraction, segmentation, and detection

## Advanced Techniques

- [Deep Learning with OpenCV](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/deep-learning): Deep learning integration guide with TensorFlow, Keras, and image classification
- [Advanced Topics in OpenCV](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/advanced): Advanced OpenCV topics including stereo vision, calibration, and image stitching

## Best Practices & Optimization

- [OpenCV Best Practices](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/best-practices): Best practices for optimization, GPU acceleration, and efficient OpenCV coding

## Real-World Applications

- [How OpenCV is Used in the Real World](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/applications): Real-world OpenCV applications in robotics, surveillance, and 3D reconstruction

## Optional

- [Matlab Tutorials](https://www.opencvhelp.org/tutorials/matlab): MATLAB tutorials for computer vision including matrix operations and visualization
